reason: This capture's benchmark_protocol_commit references 7b9d99ba6ecfae6dc53620362e87e776655ecb3b, the earliest commit at which both this case's content and the capture harness (agent_harness.py) were simultaneously present in this repository's history. A later, stricter independent review found that agent_harness.recompute_benchmark_protocol_commit_verification only ever checked full prompt-package content-equality, never whether the referenced commit also carried benchmarks/agent_quality/protocol_registry.json (the predeclared config-a/config-b registry) -- so a capture's provider/model/agent-type/tool/invocation-kind was never actually cross-checked against a committed configuration, only its prompt bytes. protocol_registry.json did not exist at all until the protocol-freeze commit 5c7289b, strictly after this capture was generated and ingested. Content-equality with the currently-committed protocol still holds (verified independently), but the registry/config was not itself committed before this capture, so it fails the strengthened verification. Withdrawn and replaced with a fresh capture generated after 5c7289b, which does carry a committed protocol_registry.json.

discovered_by.method: Review of recompute_benchmark_protocol_commit_verification's implementation found it never loaded or checked protocol_registry.json at the referenced commit, only the prompt-package manifest; re-running the strengthened check against this capture's referenced commit confirmed no registry existed there.
